title: TLS cert renewed — permanent auto-renew restored
description:
pipeshare.live HTTPS was expired (since Sep 26), which broke the desktop app and browser with certificate errors and blocked portal script loads.

The apex certificate was reissued (valid through Dec 30). Auto-renew was failing because techpipe.pipeshare.net was stuck on the webroot cert while tenant HTTP did not serve ACME challenges. Apex cert is apex-only again; tenants use the separate *.pipeshare.net wildcard. certbot.timer, nginx reload hook, and tenant ACME vhost are installed for good.

Who is affected: everyone on pipeshare.live / pipeshare.net / desktop PipeShare.
changeLog: Renewed expired pipeshare.live TLS certificate (valid to 2026-12-30).
Removed tenant SAN from apex webroot cert so certbot renew succeeds.
Enabled certbot.timer + nginx reload deploy hook.
Installed tenant ACME vhost; tenants use *.pipeshare.net wildcard cert.
